summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an underwriting agreement, indenture and officer's certificate for a $2.5 billion two-tranche senior notes offering by subsidiary Stellantis Finance US Inc., guaranteed by Stellantis N.V. The deal comprises $1.25 billion of 6.750% fixed-rate notes due 2031 and $1.25 billion of 7.400% fixed-rate notes due 2036, priced September 10, 2026 and settled September 16, 2026, with Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Intesa Sanpaolo, Morgan Stanley, RBC and SMBC Nikko as underwriters. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation.
